dialogues.jp: 何か、鳴ってるぞ。
dialogues.en: What's that noise...
dialogues.text: What's that noise...

dialogues.jp: わかった、わかった、起きるよ。
dialogues.en: Alright, alright, I'm getting up.
dialogues.text: Alright, alright, I'm getting up.

dialogues.jp: しかし、うるさい目覚ましだな。
dialogues.en: What a noisy way to wake up.
dialogues.text: What a noisy way to wake up.

dialogues.jp: ……あれ？　俺、今止めたよな。
dialogues.en: ...Ah? I'm up, but...
dialogues.text: ...Ah? I'm up, but...

dialogues.jp: まだ音がしてる。
dialogues.en: That sound's still there...
dialogues.text: That sound's still there...

dialogues.jp: 目を覚ますと、それが電話の音だと気づく。
dialogues.en:
Shaking off my sleepiness, I finally recognized it as the
telephone ringing.
dialogues.text:
Shaking off my sleepiness, I finally recognized it as the
telephone ringing.

dialogues.jp: そっか。
dialogues.en: That's right...
dialogues.text: That's right...

dialogues.jp: 音夢のやつ、いないんだっけ。
dialogues.en: That Nemu ain't here anymore.
dialogues.text: That Nemu ain't here anymore.

dialogues.jp: 「おっと、電話だっけ」
dialogues.en: "Better go answer it..."
dialogues.text: "Better go answer it..."

dialogues.jp:
俺はしぶしぶベッドから出て、玄関へと下りて
いった。
dialogues.en: I jumped off the bed, and rushed down the stairs.
dialogues.text: I jumped off the bed, and rushed down the stairs.

dialogues.jp: 玄関では電話が鳴りつづけていた。
dialogues.en: Down to the entranceway, the source of the noise.
dialogues.text: Down to the entranceway, the source of the noise.

dialogues.jp: 俺は催促がうるさい電話の受話器を取り上げる。
dialogues.en: I finally abided to it's request.
dialogues.text: I finally abided to it's request.

dialogues.jp: 「もしもし」
dialogues.en: "Hello."
dialogues.text: "Hello."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 『朝倉様？　おはようございます』
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama? Good morning."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama? Good morning."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ、環か」
dialogues.en: "Ah, Tamaki."
dialogues.text: "Ah, Tamaki."

dialogues.jp:
今日、今から会うってのに、何でわざわざ電話
なんか……。
dialogues.en: We're going to meet today... why'd she call for?
dialogues.text: We're going to meet today... why'd she call for?

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 『ごめんなさい』
dialogues.en: "I'm terribly sorry."
dialogues.text: "I'm terribly sorry."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「いいよ。ちょうど起きようと思ってたから」
dialogues.en: "It's fine, I should be waking up around now anyway."
dialogues.text: "It's fine, I should be waking up around now anyway."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 『……いえ、そのことではなく』
dialogues.en: "...I was not referring to that."
dialogues.text: "...I was not referring to that."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Ehh?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh?"

dialogues.jp: 環の声が曇っている。何か、あったのか？
dialogues.en: Tamaki's voice had grown moody. Did something happen?
dialogues.text: Tamaki's voice had grown moody. Did something happen?

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
『実は、今日のデートには行けなくなってしま
　いました』
dialogues.en: "I meant that I would not be able to make today's date."
dialogues.text: "I meant that I would not be able to make today's date."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Ehhhh?"
dialogues.text: "Ehhhh?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「いけなくなった？」
dialogues.en: "You can't make it?"
dialogues.text: "You can't make it?"

dialogues.jp: どうしたんだろう、突然。
dialogues.en: Why so suddenly?
dialogues.text: Why so suddenly?

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 『ごめんなさい』
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry."
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「どうしたんだ？　なにかあったのか？」
dialogues.en: "What's wrong? Are you okay?"
dialogues.text: "What's wrong? Are you okay?"

dialogues.jp: 環がドタキャンなんて、らしくないな。
dialogues.en: It isn't like her at all to be this abrupt.
dialogues.text: It isn't like her at all to be this abrupt.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 『ごめんなさい。理由は聞かないで……』
dialogues.en: "I'm so sorry... I can't tell you why..."
dialogues.text: "I'm so sorry... I can't tell you why..."

dialogues.jp: 環？
dialogues.en: Tamaki?
dialogues.text: Tamaki?

dialogues.jp: 泣いてるのか？
dialogues.en: Is she... crying?
dialogues.text: Is she... crying?

dialogues.jp: 「おい、環」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Tamaki-"
dialogues.text: "Hey, Tamaki-"

dialogues.jp: ──ブツっ。
dialogues.en: ──*bzzt*
dialogues.text: ──*bzzt*

dialogues.jp: そこで電話は切れてしまう。
dialogues.en: The phone clicked on the other end.
dialogues.text: The phone clicked on the other end.

dialogues.jp: 「おい、環！　もしもし？」
dialogues.en: "Oy, Tamaki! Hello!?"
dialogues.text: "Oy, Tamaki! Hello!?"

dialogues.jp: 途切れた信号音だけが、受話器から空しく響く。
dialogues.en:
But all the remained was the monotone of the interrupted
dial tone.
dialogues.text:
But all the remained was the monotone of the interrupted
dial tone.

dialogues.jp:
いったいどうしたんだろう。泣いているなんて
ただごとじゃあない。
dialogues.en:
What happened to her... she was crying about it, it can't be
any normal thing.
dialogues.text:
What happened to her... she was crying about it, it can't be
any normal thing.

dialogues.jp: 何か、気にしてるのか？
dialogues.en: What was she so worried about?
dialogues.text: What was she so worried about?

dialogues.jp:
ひょっとして、この間の夢と何か関係があるの
だろうか？
dialogues.en: Maybe it has something to do with the dream of hers I saw?
dialogues.text: Maybe it has something to do with the dream of hers I saw?

dialogues.jp: 環と、俺が結ばれないという夢……。
dialogues.en: The dream where we were fated not to be together...
dialogues.text: The dream where we were fated not to be together...

dialogues.jp: もし、俺が環だったら、どうしてた？
dialogues.en: Perhaps that's exactly why she's doing this.
dialogues.text: Perhaps that's exactly why she's doing this.

dialogues.jp:
相手に深入りしないように、距離をおいたかも
しれない。
dialogues.en:
Trying not to get too deep into our relationship, keeping
distance between ourselves.
dialogues.text:
Trying not to get too deep into our relationship, keeping
distance between ourselves.

dialogues.jp: 楽しんだ数だけ、悲しみも深くなる。
dialogues.en:
The happier the times that we spend together, the worse it
gets.
dialogues.text:
The happier the times that we spend together, the worse it
gets.

dialogues.jp: 親しくなった分だけ、離れるのが淋しくなる。
dialogues.en:
After tasting such warmth, seeing it fade away would be
entirely too painful.
dialogues.text:
After tasting such warmth, seeing it fade away would be
entirely too painful.

dialogues.jp: だったら、最初から離れていた方がいい。
dialogues.en: So we would keep our distance from each other...
dialogues.text: So we would keep our distance from each other...

dialogues.jp: 傷つかずに済むから。
dialogues.en: ...To keep us from hurting ourselves.
dialogues.text: ...To keep us from hurting ourselves.

dialogues.jp: そうなのかな。そうことなのか？　環。
dialogues.en: Is that... is that what you're trying to do, Tamaki?
dialogues.text: Is that... is that what you're trying to do, Tamaki?

dialogues.jp:
……俺は、環が好きで、環もきっと、俺のこと
が好きで。
dialogues.en: ...I'm in love with her. I'm sure she feels the same.
dialogues.text: ...I'm in love with her. I'm sure she feels the same.

dialogues.jp: だったら、まだ訪れてもいない未来なんて！
dialogues.en:
So why the hell should we worry about a future that we
haven't even experienced!
dialogues.text:
So why the hell should we worry about a future that we
haven't even experienced!

dialogues.jp: 俺は急いで部屋に駆け上がると、
dialogues.en: I quickly ran back up to my room.
dialogues.text: I quickly ran back up to my room.

dialogues.jp: 着替えて外へと飛び出した。
dialogues.en: In a flash, I'd changed and flew out the door.
dialogues.text: In a flash, I'd changed and flew out the door.

dialogues.jp:
環と俺が結ばれないなんて、決められててたま
るものか！
dialogues.en:
No one's going to decide for us whether we should be
together or not!
dialogues.text:
No one's going to decide for us whether we should be
together or not!

dialogues.jp:
俺は、神社の石段を駆け上がり、境内に到着す
る。
dialogues.en:
I dashed up the stairs to the shrine, and reached the
entrance.
dialogues.text:
I dashed up the stairs to the shrine, and reached the
entrance.

dialogues.jp:
さっきから走りっぱなしで、喉がカラカラだ。
でも、速度を緩める訳にはいかない。
dialogues.en:
Having ran all the way here, I was gasping for air. Yet, I
had no intention of slowing down.
dialogues.text:
Having ran all the way here, I was gasping for air. Yet, I
had no intention of slowing down.

dialogues.jp:
ぼやぼやしていたら、環がどこかへ行ってしま
うかもしれない。
dialogues.en: Who knows where she'd go if I don't hurry.
dialogues.text: Who knows where she'd go if I don't hurry.

dialogues.jp: そんな不安が、俺を駆り立てていた。
dialogues.en: That worry was what kept me going on.
dialogues.text: That worry was what kept me going on.

dialogues.jp:
ある日、突然に別れを告げられる。いつもいた
はずの人間がいなくなってしまう。
dialogues.en:
A day where the one you've always been with, decides to part
ways with you.
dialogues.text:
A day where the one you've always been with, decides to part
ways with you.

dialogues.jp: いるべき人がいなくなる。
dialogues.en: The one who's always been there, no longer being around.
dialogues.text: The one who's always been there, no longer being around.

dialogues.jp: いてほしい人がいなくなる。
dialogues.en:
The one who I've always wanted to be there, no longer being
around.
dialogues.text:
The one who I've always wanted to be there, no longer being
around.

dialogues.jp: そんなの、冗談じゃない。
dialogues.en: That's no laughing matter.
dialogues.text: That's no laughing matter.

dialogues.jp: 「っくそ！」
dialogues.en: "Damnit!"
dialogues.text: "Damnit!"

dialogues.jp: 足がもつれて転びそうになる。
dialogues.en: I sped up my pace even more.
dialogues.text: I sped up my pace even more.

dialogues.jp: 「はあ、はあ、ふぅ」
dialogues.en: "Haah, haah, hoo..."
dialogues.text: "Haah, haah, hoo..."

dialogues.jp: 心臓が痛い。
dialogues.en: My heart is pounding, aching.
dialogues.text: My heart is pounding, aching.

dialogues.jp:
酸素が足りないのか、肺と心臓がフル活動して
いる。ちょっと過労だったか。
dialogues.en:
With little oxygen going into my body, my lungs and heart
were working overtime.
dialogues.text:
With little oxygen going into my body, my lungs and heart
were working overtime.

dialogues.jp: んなことはどうでもいい！
dialogues.en: But who cares about that!
dialogues.text: But who cares about that!

dialogues.jp: 「環、どこだ？」
dialogues.en: "Tamaki, where are you?"
dialogues.text: "Tamaki, where are you?"

dialogues.jp:
息を整えながら、境内を見渡す。いつも、環は
この場所にいた。
dialogues.en:
Calming my haggard breathing, I looked around the area.
Tamaki would always be here.
dialogues.text:
Calming my haggard breathing, I looked around the area.
Tamaki would always be here.

dialogues.jp: 「どこだよ」
dialogues.en: "Where did you go?"
dialogues.text: "Where did you go?"

dialogues.jp: ひょっとして、神社じゃない場所にいるのか？
dialogues.en: Maybe she went somewhere?
dialogues.text: Maybe she went somewhere?

dialogues.jp: いや、それはないだろう。
dialogues.en: ...No, she couldn't have.
dialogues.text: ...No, she couldn't have.

dialogues.jp: 多分、環にとって、｛ここ／神社｝が一番落ち着くはずだ。
dialogues.en:
For Tamaki, I'm sure this is the place where she feels more
relaxed.
dialogues.text:
For Tamaki, I'm sure this is the place where she feels more
relaxed.

dialogues.jp: じゃ、神社で環が最も落ち着く場所は……？
dialogues.en:
Then, the place within the shrine that calms her the most...
would be...?
dialogues.text:
Then, the place within the shrine that calms her the most...
would be...?

dialogues.jp:
よく考えろ。環にとって、ここで最も安らぐの
は……。
dialogues.en:
I thought about it long and hard. The place where she feels
most safe...
dialogues.text:
I thought about it long and hard. The place where she feels
most safe...

dialogues.jp: 「あそこか……」
dialogues.en: "It has to be there..."
dialogues.text: "It has to be there..."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、｛まき／槙｝の木に向かって走り出した。
dialogues.en: I ran for the large tree in the compound.
dialogues.text: I ran for the large tree in the compound.

dialogues.jp: 思ったとおりだ。
dialogues.en: Just as I had guessed.
dialogues.text: Just as I had guessed.

dialogues.jp: 槙の木を見上げると巫女装束の環が座っている。
dialogues.en:
I'd looked up at the tree, to see the Miko-costume-clad
Tamaki sitting on one of it's branches.
dialogues.text:
I'd looked up at the tree, to see the Miko-costume-clad
Tamaki sitting on one of it's branches.

dialogues.jp: 環の緋の袴が、風にゆらゆら揺れていた。
dialogues.en: Her scarlet hakama was fluttering to the whims of the wind.
dialogues.text: Her scarlet hakama was fluttering to the whims of the wind.

dialogues.jp: 俺は大きく深呼吸する。
dialogues.en: I took a deep breath, and yelled out,
dialogues.text: I took a deep breath, and yelled out,

dialogues.jp: 「──なあ、そこ、気持ちいいだろう？」
dialogues.en: "──Hey, how's the air up there?"
dialogues.text: "──Hey, how's the air up there?"

dialogues.jp: 俺の声に気づき、環が下を見る。
dialogues.en: Alerted by the voice, she looked down at it's owner.
dialogues.text: Alerted by the voice, she looked down at it's owner.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様……」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama..."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「どうだ、そこは？」
dialogues.en: "It's an awesome feeling being there, isn't it?"
dialogues.text: "It's an awesome feeling being there, isn't it?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「俺も、そこが大好きだったんだ」
dialogues.en: "I love to sit on high tree branches like that, too."
dialogues.text: "I love to sit on high tree branches like that, too."

dialogues.jp:
俺は槙の木に上ろうと、柵を超え、幹に足を掛
ける。
dialogues.en:
I jumped over the fencing, and put a foot on the tree trunk,
getting ready to climb it.
dialogues.text:
I jumped over the fencing, and put a foot on the tree trunk,
getting ready to climb it.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「来ないで下さい！」
dialogues.en: "Please, don't come any closer!"
dialogues.text: "Please, don't come any closer!"

dialogues.jp: 環は俺に向かって叫ぶ。
dialogues.en: Her voice screamed out to me from above.
dialogues.text: Her voice screamed out to me from above.

dialogues.jp: 「どうしてだよ」
dialogues.en: "Why not?"
dialogues.text: "Why not?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「どうしてもです」
dialogues.en: "Because!"
dialogues.text: "Because!"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「訳を言ってくれないのか？」
dialogues.en: "You don't have a reason, huh?"
dialogues.text: "You don't have a reason, huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「今、そこに行くよ」
dialogues.en: "I'm coming up."
dialogues.text: "I'm coming up."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ダメです！」
dialogues.en: "Don't!"
dialogues.text: "Don't!"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Tamaki..."
dialogues.text: "Tamaki..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「今、朝倉様に来られたら、私、どうにかなっ
　てしまうかもしれない」
dialogues.en:
"If you come here now, I won't be able to hold myself back
anymore..."
dialogues.text:
"If you come here now, I won't be able to hold myself back
anymore..."

dialogues.jp: 環は、悲痛な顔をして俺に訴える。
dialogues.en: She pleaded me, her pain evident in her expression.
dialogues.text: She pleaded me, her pain evident in her expression.

dialogues.en: "Ehh?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「お願いだから、来ないで……」
dialogues.en: "Please, don't come..."
dialogues.text: "Please, don't come..."

dialogues.jp: 環の目に、涙が溢れ出す。
dialogues.en: Tears were flowing from her eyes,
dialogues.text: Tears were flowing from her eyes,

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「私、ずっとあなたに……」
dialogues.en: "I've always..."
dialogues.text: "I've always..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ずっとあなたに……恋してたんです！」
dialogues.en: "Always... been in love with you!"
dialogues.text: "Always... been in love with you!"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Tamaki..."
dialogues.text: "Tamaki..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「でも……、でもっ！」
dialogues.en: "But... but...!"
dialogues.text: "But... but...!"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「でも、なんだよ？」
dialogues.en: "But, what?"
dialogues.text: "But, what?"

dialogues.jp: その先は、わかってる。
dialogues.en: I asked, even though I knew the answer already.
dialogues.text: I asked, even though I knew the answer already.

dialogues.jp: ワタシタチハ、ムスバレナイ。
dialogues.en: Our Futures Are Seperate.
dialogues.text: Our Futures Are Seperate.

dialogues.jp:
俺達は、結ばれない未来を持っているから。だ
から、一緒にはなれない。
dialogues.en: We have futures that are seperate. So, we can't be together.
dialogues.text: We have futures that are seperate. So, we can't be together.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「わたくしが告白して、振られてしまう未来が
　見えてしまったんです」
dialogues.en:
"I saw the future... where I had confessed, and was
rejected."
dialogues.text:
"I saw the future... where I had confessed, and was
rejected."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「わたくしとは結ばれない未来が……」
dialogues.en: "The future where our paths were seperate..."
dialogues.text: "The future where our paths were seperate..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「それを信じているのか？」
dialogues.en: "And you believed in that?"
dialogues.text: "And you believed in that?"

dialogues.jp:
環は、こぼれ落ちる涙をぐっと堪えて、首を横
に振った。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki, trying desperately to control her tears, shook her
head.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki, trying desperately to control her tears, shook her
head.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「だから、希望を持っていられたんです。将来、
　一緒にいられると思ってた」
dialogues.en:
"I still harbourued hopes... that we would be together in
the future..."
dialogues.text:
"I still harbourued hopes... that we would be together in
the future..."

dialogues.jp:
それでも堪えきれなくて、環の瞳から、無数の
涙が流れ落ちる。
dialogues.en: Yet no matter how hard she tried, the tears kept falling.
dialogues.text: Yet no matter how hard she tried, the tears kept falling.

dialogues.jp:
落ちた涙はまるで、槙の木の中に、雨のように
染みていった。
dialogues.en: Beating onto the tree below her, like drops of rain.
dialogues.text: Beating onto the tree below her, like drops of rain.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「でも、違った……。あなたとわたくしの未来
　なんて、何処にもなかった……」
dialogues.en:
"But it was wrong... no matter how hard I try, I can't fight
the future..."
dialogues.text:
"But it was wrong... no matter how hard I try, I can't fight
the future..."

dialogues.jp: さめざめと涙が零れていく。
dialogues.en: Her words grew more and more sorrowful.
dialogues.text: Her words grew more and more sorrowful.

dialogues.jp:
「それでも俺達は、うまくやっていたじゃない
　か。一緒にデートだってしたじゃないか」
dialogues.en:
"What does the future matter to what is happening now? We
went on a date together, didn't we?"
dialogues.text:
"What does the future matter to what is happening now? We
went on a date together, didn't we?"

dialogues.jp:
あの──、あの楽しい一時がウソだって言うの
か。全部まやかしだったというのか。
dialogues.en:
That time, one of the best times of my life, it wasn't just
a facade.
dialogues.text:
That time, one of the best times of my life, it wasn't just
a facade.

dialogues.jp:
「俺は、環と──いつかは結ばれる。そう思っ
　ていた。子どもの頃の約束を果たすのも悪く
　ない、そう思ってた」
dialogues.en:
"We've always been connected to each other. It wouldn't be
bad at all if we carry out the promise we made as kids."
dialogues.text:
"We've always been connected to each other. It wouldn't be
bad at all if we carry out the promise we made as kids."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そう思って、ずっと我慢してきたんです」
dialogues.en: "You are only denying the inevitable..."
dialogues.text: "You are only denying the inevitable..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "The inevitable...?"
dialogues.text: "The inevitable...?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「……でも、あなたと過ごしていて……もう、
　心が抑えきれない」
dialogues.en:
"...And spending time with you... my heart cannot restrain
itself much longer..."
dialogues.text:
"...And spending time with you... my heart cannot restrain
itself much longer..."

dialogues.jp: 環は手のひらで顔を覆い、泣き出してしまった。
dialogues.en: Tamaki covered her face, and her tears, with her hand.
dialogues.text: Tamaki covered her face, and her tears, with her hand.

dialogues.jp:
感情が一気に爆発し、流れ出し、抑えがきかな
くなってしまったのだろう。
dialogues.en:
All her feelings exploding out like that... it's not like
she's restraining herself now either.
dialogues.text:
All her feelings exploding out like that... it's not like
she's restraining herself now either.

dialogues.jp: 「どうして、我慢なんかするんだよ？」
dialogues.en: "How is what I'm doing, denial?"
dialogues.text: "How is what I'm doing, denial?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「我慢する必要なんて、ないだろ！」
dialogues.en: "There's nothing I need to deny whatsoever!"
dialogues.text: "There's nothing I need to deny whatsoever!"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「俺はお前のそばにいる。そうだろ？　それ
　じゃあ、二人の未来は信じられないってい
　うのか？」
dialogues.en:
"I'm always at your side, aren't I? You can't believe in a
future for us despite that?"
dialogues.text:
"I'm always at your side, aren't I? You can't believe in a
future for us despite that?"

dialogues.jp: どうして、未来なんかに縛られるんだ。
dialogues.en: Why do we have to follow some pre-determined future.
dialogues.text: Why do we have to follow some pre-determined future.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、溢れ出しそうな言葉を飲み込む。
dialogues.en: I swallowed all my emotions up, and readied myself.
dialogues.text: I swallowed all my emotions up, and readied myself.

dialogues.jp: 「今、行く！　待ってろ！」
dialogues.en: "I'm coming up now! Wait for me!"
dialogues.text: "I'm coming up now! Wait for me!"

dialogues.jp: 俺は再び、木に登ろうとする。
dialogues.en: Once again, I began climbing the tree.
dialogues.text: Once again, I began climbing the tree.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「来ないで！」
dialogues.en: "Don't!"
dialogues.text: "Don't!"

dialogues.jp: でも、俺はひるまない。
dialogues.en: But, I won't be stopped now.
dialogues.text: But, I won't be stopped now.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「お願いです。これ以上、辛い思いをさせない
　で下さい！」
dialogues.en:
"Please! Don't make things even more painful than they are
now!"
dialogues.text:
"Please! Don't make things even more painful than they are
now!"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「二人は、結ばれないんです」
dialogues.en: "Our futures are seperate!"
dialogues.text: "Our futures are seperate!"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「んなわけ、あるか！」
dialogues.en: "Like hell they are!"
dialogues.text: "Like hell they are!"

dialogues.jp: 悲鳴に近い環の声を俺は打ち消した。
dialogues.en: I nixed her objections with a simple negative.
dialogues.text: I nixed her objections with a simple negative.

dialogues.jp: 結ばれないはずが、ない。
dialogues.en: We don't have to be seperate, at all.
dialogues.text: We don't have to be seperate, at all.

dialogues.jp: だって、お互いがこんなに想っているのだから。
dialogues.en: Not as long as we have the feelings we do for each other.
dialogues.text: Not as long as we have the feelings we do for each other.

dialogues.jp: 想いが届かないはずは無い。
dialogues.en: Those feeling shouldn't ever be disregarded.
dialogues.text: Those feeling shouldn't ever be disregarded.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、環にお構いなく、どんどん木に登る。
dialogues.en: I hurried up the tree, wanting to be by her side.
dialogues.text: I hurried up the tree, wanting to be by her side.

dialogues.jp: 小さいときよりも、容易に登れる。
dialogues.en: This is far easier than when I was a kid.
dialogues.text: This is far easier than when I was a kid.

dialogues.jp: そして俺は、環の隣にたちまち到達した。
dialogues.en: I finally arrived on her branch.
dialogues.text: I finally arrived on her branch.

dialogues.jp: 「──もう着いちゃったよ」
dialogues.en: "──I'm here."
dialogues.text: "──I'm here."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……朝倉様」
dialogues.en: "...Asakura-sama."
dialogues.text: "...Asakura-sama."

dialogues.jp: 環は、涙顔で俺を見つめている。
dialogues.en: Tamaki looked at me with tear-stained eyes.
dialogues.text: Tamaki looked at me with tear-stained eyes.

dialogues.jp: 「俺はお前のそばにいたい」
dialogues.en: "I want to be with you."
dialogues.text: "I want to be with you."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「信じられないか？」
dialogues.en: "You don't believe me?"
dialogues.text: "You don't believe me?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ううん……」

ゆっくりと左右に首を振る環の瞳に、俺の顔が
映る。涙で光っていた。
dialogues.en: She slowly shook her head, her teardrops glistening.
dialogues.text: She slowly shook her head, her teardrops glistening.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、抑え切れなくなった。
dialogues.en: I couldn't hold back any longer.
dialogues.text: I couldn't hold back any longer.

dialogues.en: "Tamaki....!"
dialogues.text: "Tamaki....!"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あ、朝倉様……！」
dialogues.en: "A, Asakura-sama...!"
dialogues.text: "A, Asakura-sama...!"

dialogues.jp: 俺は環を抱きしめる。
dialogues.en: I hugged her slender frame tightly.
dialogues.text: I hugged her slender frame tightly.

dialogues.jp: 環の唇が、洋服を通して、俺の肌に触れる。
dialogues.en: Her lips lightly brushed my clothes.
dialogues.text: Her lips lightly brushed my clothes.

dialogues.jp: シャンプーの香りがする。
dialogues.en: Her shampoo's scent tickled my nostrils.
dialogues.text: Her shampoo's scent tickled my nostrils.

dialogues.jp: 環の体温が、俺の体温と重なる。
dialogues.en: The heat of our bodies melded together.
dialogues.text: The heat of our bodies melded together.

dialogues.jp: 心臓の音が、俺の耳に聞こえてくる。
dialogues.en: The beating of her heart was plain as day to my ears.
dialogues.text: The beating of her heart was plain as day to my ears.

dialogues.jp: 多分、それより速く俺の心臓は波打っている。
dialogues.en: It wasn't easy to tell whether mine or hers was faster.
dialogues.text: It wasn't easy to tell whether mine or hers was faster.

dialogues.jp: 環に聞こえてしまうだろう。
dialogues.en: She needs to hear it from me...
dialogues.text: She needs to hear it from me...

dialogues.jp: 環が、好きだ。
dialogues.en: That I love her.
dialogues.text: That I love her.

dialogues.jp: 「俺が告白する未来は見えたのか？」
dialogues.en: "Did you see any future where I confessed?"
dialogues.text: "Did you see any future where I confessed?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Ehh?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「俺が環に告白する未来さ」
dialogues.en: "A future where I confessed to you."
dialogues.text: "A future where I confessed to you."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「それは……」
dialogues.en: "That is..."
dialogues.text: "That is..."

dialogues.jp: 環は驚いて俺の顔を見る。
dialogues.en: Tamaki looked at me, shocked.
dialogues.text: Tamaki looked at me, shocked.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、環の頬についた涙を拭ってやる。
dialogues.en: I wiped the tears of her cheek.
dialogues.text: I wiped the tears of her cheek.

dialogues.jp:
「環が告白して、うまくいかないんだったら、
　俺が環に告白すればいい」
dialogues.en: "If you can't confess... then I'd do it."
dialogues.text: "If you can't confess... then I'd do it."

dialogues.jp:
そう。そんなくだらない未来、こっちから壊し
てやる。
dialogues.en: I'd kill that stupid future by making a new one.
dialogues.text: I'd kill that stupid future by making a new one.

dialogues.jp:
決めるのは、俺と──環なんだ。そんな未来、
願い下げだ！
dialogues.en:
No one needs a future chosen for us. The ones who decide;
it'd be Tamaki and myself!
dialogues.text:
No one needs a future chosen for us. The ones who decide;
it'd be Tamaki and myself!

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「俺は、お前が好きだ」
dialogues.en: "I love you, Tamaki."
dialogues.text: "I love you, Tamaki."

dialogues.jp: 環の目を見つめ、告白する。
dialogues.en: Staring her straight in the eyes, I confessed.
dialogues.text: Staring her straight in the eyes, I confessed.

dialogues.jp:
「誰が、何と言おうと関係ない。俺達の未来は、
　俺達が決めればいい」
dialogues.en:
"No one else can tell us what to do. Our future is ours and
ours alone."
dialogues.text:
"No one else can tell us what to do. Our future is ours and
ours alone."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様……」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama..."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama..."

dialogues.jp: 環の心臓の音が更に速くなったような気がした。
dialogues.en: Her heartbeat became even more rapid.
dialogues.text: Her heartbeat became even more rapid.

dialogues.jp: 環の顔をじっと見つめる。
dialogues.en: Her face continued to stare at me in shock.
dialogues.text: Her face continued to stare at me in shock.

dialogues.jp: その瞳に、吸い込まれそうになる。
dialogues.en: Those eyes, which could hyponotize me easily.
dialogues.text: Those eyes, which could hyponotize me easily.

dialogues.jp: 長いまつ毛が、少し濡れていた。
dialogues.en: I stroked her long, fine hair.
dialogues.text: I stroked her long, fine hair.

dialogues.jp: 俺はゆっくりと目を閉じ、環の額にキスをする。
dialogues.en: Closing my eyes, I kissed her lightly on the forehead.
dialogues.text: Closing my eyes, I kissed her lightly on the forehead.

dialogues.jp: そして、もう一度環を見つめる。
dialogues.en: My eyes then returned to gaze at her.
dialogues.text: My eyes then returned to gaze at her.

dialogues.jp: もう、｛さえぎ／遮｝るものは何も無かった。
dialogues.en: There's nothing left to interrupt us anymore.
dialogues.text: There's nothing left to interrupt us anymore.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、環の唇に、そっと自分の唇を重ねる。
dialogues.en: I placed my lips onto hers.
dialogues.text: I placed my lips onto hers.

dialogues.jp: 柔らかくて、羽のような感触。
dialogues.en: She felt soft, like a feather.
dialogues.text: She felt soft, like a feather.

dialogues.jp: 強く抱きしめたら、壊れてしまいそうな……。
dialogues.en: Like if I held her too tightly, she'd break...
dialogues.text: Like if I held her too tightly, she'd break...

dialogues.jp: 唇が離れて、
dialogues.en: I pulled away slightly from her.
dialogues.text: I pulled away slightly from her.

dialogues.jp:
お互い見つめあうと、環の瞳にうっすらと涙が
浮かんでいた。
dialogues.en: And continued staring into each other's eyes.
dialogues.text: And continued staring into each other's eyes.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、もう一度環にキスをする。
dialogues.en: I then kissed her, again.
dialogues.text: I then kissed her, again.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様……」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama..."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama..."

dialogues.jp: 環が、俺を抱きしめる腕に力が入る。
dialogues.en: Tamaki strongly held onto me tight, within my arms.
dialogues.text: Tamaki strongly held onto me tight, within my arms.

dialogues.jp: お互い、もう離れないように、しっかりと……。
dialogues.en: Telling me, that she won't let me go either...
dialogues.text: Telling me, that she won't let me go either...

dialogues.jp: 俺も、環を強く抱きしめる。
dialogues.en: I held her even more tightly, as well.
dialogues.text: I held her even more tightly, as well.

dialogues.jp:
抱きしめあう息苦しさよりも、心臓が鳴りやま
ない息苦しさが、心地よく思える。
dialogues.en:
The pain from letting go would be even worse than the pain
from holding on tighter.
dialogues.text:
The pain from letting go would be even worse than the pain
from holding on tighter.

dialogues.jp: 離したくない。
dialogues.en: I didn't want to let go.
dialogues.text: I didn't want to let go.

dialogues.jp: この小さな身体を、ずっと守ってあげたい。
dialogues.en: I want to protect her, forever.
dialogues.text: I want to protect her, forever.

dialogues.jp: そう思った。
dialogues.en: The thought lay deep in my mind.
dialogues.text: The thought lay deep in my mind.

dialogues.jp: 俺達は、強く抱きしめあって、キスをした。
dialogues.en: Still holding each other close, we kissed again.
dialogues.text: Still holding each other close, we kissed again.

dialogues.jp: その時間を永遠と愛しむように……。
dialogues.en: A time which sprung forth an eternal love...
dialogues.text: A time which sprung forth an eternal love...

dialogues.jp: ◆槙の木の上で◆
dialogues.en: ◆On The Treetop?◆
dialogues.text: ◆On The Treetop?◆

dialogues.jp: 朝、電話の音で目が覚めると、環からだった。
dialogues.en:
I was woken up in the morning by the phone. It was Tamaki
calling.
dialogues.text:
I was woken up in the morning by the phone. It was Tamaki
calling.

dialogues.jp:
今日のデートを、急に中止させて欲しいと言っ
てくる。俺が訳を尋ねても答えようとしない。
俺は理由を確かめようと、家を飛び出した。
dialogues.en:
She wanted to cancel today's date. I was suspicious at her
being tight-lipped, and rushed out of the house.
dialogues.text:
She wanted to cancel today's date. I was suspicious at her
being tight-lipped, and rushed out of the house.

dialogues.jp:
環が何もいおうとしないことに不安を感じ、俺
は、神社へと赴く。
dialogues.en:
Worried by the things she could not say, I went to the
shrine.
dialogues.text:
Worried by the things she could not say, I went to the
shrine.

dialogues.jp: すると、槙の木の上で環が座っていた。
dialogues.en: I found Tamaki sitting on the tree branch.
dialogues.text: I found Tamaki sitting on the tree branch.

dialogues.jp:
俺が木に登ろうとすると、環は自分が俺に振ら
れている未来が見えたからと、拒絶する。
dialogues.en:
I climbed the tree to her, rejecting the future she had
seen.
dialogues.text:
I climbed the tree to her, rejecting the future she had
seen.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、環が告白し、振られる未来があるなら、
自分が環へ告白する未来を作ればいい、そう言っ
て俺の想いを告白する。
dialogues.en:
If she was afraid of the future from her confessing, then I
decided to make a new future by confessing myself.
dialogues.text:
If she was afraid of the future from her confessing, then I
decided to make a new future by confessing myself.

dialogues.jp: 二人は、強く抱き合い、キスをした。
dialogues.en: We embraced into a deep kiss.
dialogues.text: We embraced into a deep kiss.
